The Mind flayer can be found in a weakened, dying state on the Ravaged Beach during Act One.

Involvement

Act One

The mind flayer is trapped beneath debris in the Nautiloid Wreck. If a party member interacts with it, it attempts to telepathically control and have them lean in so it can consume their brain. The party member can attempt to resist through the following options:

  • [WISDOM] Resist the intrusion with everything you have. (DC 5)
  • [DRACONIC BLOODLINE] [CHARISMA] You host the blood of a mighty dragon. Channel its will to resist the abomination. (DC 5 )
  • [WILD MAGIC] [CHARISMA] Steel your will and allow your untamed magic to unbalance the creature's mind. (DC 5 )
  • [SORCERER] [CHARISMA] Draw on your willpower. Improvise a mental shield against the creature's hungry mind. (DC 5 )

Failing to resist, or willingly submitting to the mind flayer, causes their immediate death. The mind flayer then recovers hit points, becoming a weakened mind flayer, and is hostile to any remaining party members.

Otherwise, the interacting party member ends the mind flayer's life. A Dark Urge character then gains the the inspiration ⁠To Sleep, Perchance To Dream Tentacled Dreams.
